title: 50% off Most Products - eg: Endura Boots $109.50 + $15 Delivery (Free above $300 Spend) @ Rossi Boots
body:
Deal: 50% off Most Products - eg: Endura Boots $109.50 + $15 Delivery (Free above $300 Spend) @ Rossi Boots

[MenacingMan] Is the fit the same as RM? i.e size 9 in current RM, curious if I can just assume the same.
[Tech45] About half size down in Rossi for me. Rossi's seem a bit roomier.
[Chuppa] PSA on Rossi Boots - that "proud South Australian since 1910" heritage angle? Rossi was bought out by S. Kidman & Co in Dec 2023, which is majority Hancock Prospecting. So every pair chips in to Gina's war chest: burgers, and the ongoing family court saga against her own kids.
Fitting, really - Kidman is one of the biggest cattle operations in the country, so she's got the beef supply chain sorted end to end. Boots on the paddock, patty on the bun.
And before anyone says "yeah but they're Aussie made" - they're not. Not one pair. All offshore, has been for years. You're paying a premium for a flag on the box and a billionaire's legal fund.
[Pricebeat] @Binchicken22: Bulldozer sound intensifies
[ZuluOz] I owned Rossi's for years because they were made in Australia. They're all offshore now switched to Redbacks because they are made here and haven't looked back.
I know some people don't like Andrew Forrest but at least the blokes put his money where his mouth is and brought the manufacturing back to Oz.
[poppingtags] Mongrel are also made in Australia and are priced really well!

[The Magic Pudding] So are you getting a pair of Gina or Langs?
[Toporo] Not only Rossi, Drizabone has also been bought out by Gina, she has moved almost all production of Drizabones offshore to Vietnam while touting "Aussie country heritage".
Choosing between unethical billionaires to buy stuff off, I'd rather support Forrest who is actually making an effort to bring stuff back onshore, rather than the one that wants to donate our land to the Israeli.

[Lineone] I got some 503 Colts in March 2025 to replace my abused RMWs. I work in an office environment and plenty of times people have thought these were RMWs. Same one piece of leather, similar look and based on the close to 18 months of wear, are aging just as well as my RMWs.
Fit wise, I am a 10.5 in both RMW and Rossi. I would say that the Rossi is marginally less comfortable, but I have replaced the insoles as I found the standard ones seem to fit closer to a Dynamic Craftsman in the tightness in the middle of the foot, but YMMV.
I paid $319 back in March 2025 and will continue to buy these moving forwards. While my RMWs lasted 7 1/2 years, they were looking pretty cooked for the last few, so getting a new pair of these every 3-4 years is an upgrade in my eyes.
